page.layout: One text column, with short marginal marks « beside the first three lines on the right. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword "mo-" at the lower right.

main_text.p: modò nō mortuus, sed ne na« tus quidem esset, heredē esse« oportere. Atq; hāc ipsam« controuersiam Cicero & in Bruto, & in II de Oratore, eo quē exposui modo tractat. Potest autem etiam hoc tractari modo, & paulò (ut mihi uidetur) ad Iuris ciuilis disciplinam accommodatius: ut cū possessio Coponij agnati sit, petitio M. Curij substituti, ratio à Coponio subijciatur hęc: quia qui pupillariter substituit, nō testatori, sed pupillo heres attribuitur: cū aūt pupillus nullus fuerit, heres esse eiq; potest? Firmamētū Curij: at qui substituit, quocunq;

page.notes: Marginal marks « appear beside lines 1–3 with no note text printed beside them, so only the marks are transcribed. Catchword "mo-" is treated as the catchword of the next page. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. "Potest" and "esset" were read from ligatures (ft, ff) and normalised to the expected forms, so check those two readings against the scan. Hyphen after "mo-" is printed.
